about: A fast download manager for HTTP, BitTorrent, Magnet and ed2k, for desktop and phone.

prs.title: Downloaded programs keep their real names
prs.broken: Files with no extension, such as programs from GitHub releases, were saved as kubectl.bin or README.asc, so scripts that ran them by name broke.
prs.changed: I made the downloader add an extension only when the server names a real file type, not a generic one.
prs.matters: Downloaded tools run straight away without being renamed.
